title: RAW Galen writing constraint: later occurrences favor shorter members of six frozen synonym sets
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_EXECUTED. Keep every one of IDEA501's 59 whole-word guesses unchanged. A single new probabilistic spelling rule tilts later occurrences toward shorter members of all six explicitly synonymous form sets. Test only an exact, layout-conditioned ordering consequence in the already owned GDT928 paragraph packet, excluding both complete development leaves 76 and 80. No new meaning, referent identity, manuscript access, target census or experiment has been performed for this proposal.

design.mechanism: Conditional probabilistic choice among explicitly frozen whole-form synonyms: increasing within-paragraph occurrence rank modestly favors a shorter spelling while exact family-by-paragraph-by-layout form counts remain conditioned upon.
design.unit: A complete owned paragraph, its exact synonym-family occurrences, and permutations of whole forms only within one fixed layout block.
design.contrast: H0: exchangeable spelling order given exact whole-form counts, paragraph, synonym family, physical-line edge class, previous-dy class and current-dy class. H1: the same conditional inventory plus one fixed shared shortening tilt.
design.prediction: On other already owned physical leaves, H1 assigns greater conditional likelihood than H0 to the written ordering. The gain must survive the fixed layout conditioning and have the same direction in at least three powered synonym families, rather than arising only from a known line-edge preference.
design.scope: Tests the conjunction of the entire frozen Galen lexicon and this new shared spelling-choice law. A positive ordering result does not establish synonymy, Galen authorship, anaphora, historical meanings or a complete reading of the other paragraphs. A failure rejects this fixed conjunction, not the 59-value reading alone.

freeze_status.before_new_target_work: This recipe was written before reading any additional paragraph content or computing any new frequency/order census for this task. Development examples are already exposed IDEA499/501 material. Earlier project exposure, including the 507 observation packet, remains exposure; this is not reserved or blind confirmation.
freeze_status.no_execution: Only source/registry review, exact old anchor inspection, document authoring and byte-hash checks have occurred. No target selection, synonym-frequency census, fitted coefficient or manuscript score.
freeze_status.whole_reading_invariant: All 59 full entries, denotations, types and existing argument/scope requirements remain exactly as in IDEA501. Do not substitute English tags for those entries. The six sets below are the only spelling families. PEDANTS is excluded: shared reference is not an explicitly licensed additional synonym set.

pre_registration_amendment.reason: Pure design audit before target intake: unrestricted dy-ending-label swaps could alter the following occurrence PREV_DY covariate. Added CURRENT_ENDS_DY stratum before registration, retaining the resulting analytical LENTIL capacity loss. No result motivated this change.

post_registration_pretest_amendment.reason: Root review before any target census required whole-paragraph treatment of anchor_eligible uncertainty. Freeze primary eligibility as all lines anchor_eligible exactly true; retain every other whole paragraph as SOURCE_UNCERTAIN without truncation or rank reconstruction. No outcome or target count motivated this amendment.

paragraph_packet.scope: Use its already admitted complete paragraph records only. No source TSV, image, reserve, absent RF paragraph, alternative source or newly assembled span may be fetched.

six_frozen_synonym_sets.basis: r explicitly has the exact copular denotation of qoky.
okedy explicitly has the same food-kind L denotation as qokain.
san explicitly has the same food-kind-to-nourishment-profile denotation as saiiin.
All four explicitly share propositional negation before argument application. The propositions negated may differ; the rule tracks lexical-denotation recurrence, not repeated propositions.
Both explicitly denote the same food-kind T.
y explicitly denotes the same source-present community G at tau0 as ysheeyqorar.

actual_development_observations.strongest_literal_counterexample: The IS sequence at f76v positions 9,20,22,34,38,53 is qoky,r,r,qoky,qoky,r: a later form can be longer. Therefore there is no deterministic long-first/short-later rule, no monotone deletion rule and no new special exception for qoky. Every corresponding future counterexample remains in the scored inventory.
actual_development_observations.no_evidential_credit: These development examples motivated the hypothesis and count as zero test observations. Entire physical leaves 76 and 80, including their other sides and paragraphs, are excluded from future scoring.

fixed_extraction_recipe.readers: Process ZL3b, IT2a and RF1b separately, using only their existing lists in the same packet. Never pool events or p-values across readings; these are readings of one manuscript. RF1b is known to have no paragraphs in this packet and must remain NO_OWNED_PARAGRAPH_DATA, without replacement intake.
fixed_extraction_recipe.scope_filter: Before inspecting a paragraph's words, reject page selectors starting f84 and the unadmitted f116v selector; reject numeric physical leaf in {76,80}. Use the supplied page and leaf fields, requiring consistency. Retain every remaining complete paragraph in the scope denominator, including those later classified SOURCE_UNCERTAIN or having no family occurrence. Apply the separate whole_literal_eligibility rule before forming the primary literal-paragraph denominator. No best paragraphs or families may be selected.
fixed_extraction_recipe.token_identity: Exact literal equality to one of the 14 listed forms only. No normalization, brace expansion, wildcard, split/fusion, one-edit match, alias addition or conversion to BPE units. Keep all source IDs and full paragraph ID references; do not copy the full corpus into the proposal.
fixed_extraction_recipe.length: The length is the number of literal ASCII characters in the exact whole transcription form, fixed in forms_and_raw_lengths. It is not glyph count, phoneme count, ink length, component count or a meaning-length estimate. For each family define z(form)=(length-minimum family length)/(maximum-minimum), using the frozen six sets, even if a form is absent from a particular paragraph.
fixed_extraction_recipe.recurrence_rank: Within each whole-literal primary-eligible complete paragraph and family, order all exact occurrences in the supplied line/word order. If m is their number, assign occurrence j the fixed rank u=(j-1)/(m-1). For m<2 there is no order comparison. Rank is lexical-family recurrence, not an inferred same-owner or same-proposition chain. Reset only at the existing paragraph boundary.
fixed_extraction_recipe.layout_strata: For each occurrence, physical-line edge class is SINGLE if the line has one group, FIRST if index=1, LAST if index=line group count, otherwise INTERIOR. PREV_DY is true exactly when a preceding group exists on the same physical line and its unchanged raw string ends with the literal characters dy; at line start it is false. CURRENT_ENDS_DY is true exactly when this target form itself ends with dy. Form blocks by reader × complete paragraph ID × family × edge class × PREV_DY × CURRENT_ENDS_DY. Do not exchange forms between blocks. CURRENT_ENDS_DY is an essential null-integrity condition: every swapped form retains the same dy flag at its original position, so PREV_DY at every later position remains unchanged under recomputation.
fixed_extraction_recipe.mobile_block: A block is mobile if it has at least two positions and at least two distinct frozen lengths. All immobile blocks and all excluded observations remain reported with reasons. H0 and H1 are conditional on the exact multiset of whole forms in each block, not just its length histogram. This preserves paragraph topic, physical leaf, exact family composition, whole-form frequencies and the three predeclared edge/dy features.
fixed_extraction_recipe.no_hidden_target_selection: The future program must first emit the complete scope/capacity census and stop if the gates fail. It must not choose another rank, paragraph boundary, length scale, conditioning feature or eligible-family subset after viewing the result.
fixed_extraction_recipe.analytical_capacity_limit: Before any target census, the frozen LENTIL forms are known to differ in CURRENT_ENDS_DY, so that family cannot supply a mobile block under these strata. The dy-ending NOT form oltydy likewise cannot swap with the other three NOT variants. These declared losses are retained; do not remove the control, add a family, change lengths or replace the three-family capacity threshold. The other five families can in principle supply three powered families, but actual capacity is unknown.
fixed_extraction_recipe.whole_literal_eligibility: After the selector/development-leaf filter, inspect only the stored metadata of each complete paragraph. Primary-eligible means the paragraph has at least one line and every line has anchor_eligible exactly true. If any line is false, missing or nonboolean, classify the ENTIRE paragraph SOURCE_UNCERTAIN, retain its exact paragraph ID, whole boundary, stored group count and all line eligibility metadata in the scope manifest, and do not use any of its groups for recurrence ranks, mobile blocks, model scores or nulls. Never remove individual uncertain groups or lines and rebuild a truncated paragraph. The full scope manifest retains literal, SOURCE_UNCERTAIN, no-family and immobile paragraphs separately. The actual counts in all classes are unknown before the future census.

fixed_probability_models.H0: For a mobile block b with n positions and exact counts c_w, every distinct assignment sigma of that multiset to its fixed positions has probability 1/N_b, where N_b=n!/product_w(c_w!).
fixed_probability_models.H1: For the same assignments, E_b(sigma)=sum_i u_i*z(w_sigma(i)); P1(sigma|b)=exp(-beta*E_b(sigma))/Z_b; beta=ln(3) exactly, shared by every form, family, paragraph, leaf and reader. Z_b sums exp(-beta*E) over all distinct multiset assignments. For a two-position block spanning u=0 to u=1 with the family's shortest and longest forms, the shorter-last order has probability 3/4. Intermediate rank or length differences have a smaller fixed tilt.
fixed_probability_models.fitting: Zero fitted coefficients, family-specific slopes, direction changes, learned exceptions or latent context states. H1 is a fully specified conditional spelling-choice model; the already observed whole-form multiset is conditioned upon, not predicted. It does not predict which synonym family occurs, how often it occurs, or any absent spelling.
fixed_probability_models.exact_evaluation: Compute log Z by a numerically stable dynamic program over consumed counts of each exact form, assigning the next fixed position in order; do not multiply by c_w because assignments are distinct multiset strings. The state count is product_w(c_w+1). Per block, gain_bits=log2(P1(observed)/P0(observed)). Retain all block gains, including negative ones.
fixed_probability_models.complexity_stop: If any mobile block exceeds 100000 dynamic-programming count states, or exact evaluation cannot finish within the total declared wall-time budget, stop as ENGINEERING_BUDGET_OR_STATE_CAP, without deleting that block or replacing exact Z by a fitted/approximate model.
fixed_probability_models.primary_score: For each physical leaf f, divide its sum of mobile-block gain_bits by its total number of mobile positions. Primary G is the unweighted mean of these per-leaf gains. Families are also scored by this same physical-leaf-balanced rule within their own events. No family score is used to choose a subset.

frozen_capacity_null_and_outcomes.capacity_per_reader: At least 20 mobile blocks, 40 mobile positions and 5 physical leaves; at least 3 of the 6 fixed families must each have at least 4 mobile blocks on at least 3 leaves. All six families remain in the global score whether powered or not. Thresholds are frozen before the census. Failure gives NO_CAPACITY, not a semantic or spelling-rule contradiction.
frozen_capacity_null_and_outcomes.conditional_null: Use 4095 independently sampled worlds, numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(2026092201)); for each world, traverse readers in ZL3b,IT2a,RF1b order and blocks sorted by paragraph ID, family list order, edge class, PREV_DY and CURRENT_ENDS_DY; independently permute the list of whole-form labels within every mobile block. Recompute each world's G. Raw positions, ranks and all conditioned multisets stay fixed. p_upper=(1+count(G_null>=G_observed))/4096; p_lower analogously. Report realized label mobility and the full leaf/family contributions. Failure of a separately applicable relation-packet gate is an invalid scoring input, never a positive result.
frozen_capacity_null_and_outcomes.within_reader_support: All capacity gates hold, G>0, p_upper<=0.05, at least 60 percent of scored physical leaves have positive gain, and at least 3 powered synonym families have positive gain. No rounding of thresholds. This is support only for the fixed conditional writing constraint on this reading.
frozen_capacity_null_and_outcomes.overall_retained_lead: Require within_reader_support for both ZL3b and IT2a. RF1b remains explicitly unavailable. If one reader lacks capacity or the signs disagree, report the specific reader-limited result; do not declare a manuscript-wide survivor or compensate by pooling.
frozen_capacity_null_and_outcomes.negative_or_mixed: With adequate capacity, G<=0 fails the registered predictive requirement of this fixed rule. G<0 with p_lower<=0.05 is a directionally adverse result against the exchangeable comparator. Positive G without all support gates is inconclusive. Neither result invalidates the 59-value reading by itself; each changes whether that whole reading may retain THIS extra universal spelling law.
frozen_capacity_null_and_outcomes.scientific_decision: A retained lead permits one future independently reviewed use of the same shortening law as a constraint on continuing the Galen reading. Every new form or exception would require a new declared model. A failure removes this added shared law, leaving the old whole reading explicitly less constrained. It does not start a search over alternative lengths, coefficients, subsets or paragraph definitions.

named_freedoms_and_limits.inherited: 59 unconfirmed whole values, their already declared synonym choices, productions, referents and scopes remain prior assumptions; they are not confirmed by this recipe.
named_freedoms_and_limits.new_discrete_choices: Exactly six explicit synonym sets (14 forms); exact raw-character length with family min/max normalization; all-lines-anchor_eligible-true complete paragraph eligibility and reset; normalized occurrence rank; four physical-line edge states; one PREV_DY bit; one CURRENT_ENDS_DY bit preserving null-context consistency; two entire development-leaf exclusions; the conditional multiset model and the stated primary/robustness gates.
named_freedoms_and_limits.new_numeric_choices: One fixed shared beta=ln(3), zero trained semantic or statistical parameters; the explicit capacity thresholds, 4095 null worlds and one fixed seed; 100000 DP-state stop and 35-minute total future execution budget.
named_freedoms_and_limits.whole_form_residual: Conditioning on each exact whole-form multiset deliberately leaves lexicalized family/paragraph/layout frequencies free. This rule predicts order only; it is not a complete production grammar or a claim that all spellings are interchangeable in all contexts.
named_freedoms_and_limits.known_confounding_rival: Long forms and short forms may have different syntactic slots, argument structures or local neighbor selection despite the guessed denotation identity. Exact paragraph, edge, PREV_DY and CURRENT_ENDS_DY conditioning removes only the named nuisances. Remaining syntax or local copying can also yield shortening order; a positive result cannot select historical meaning over those rivals.
named_freedoms_and_limits.no_new_meaning: No new gloss, semantic type, participant identity, word segmentation, prefix/suffix meaning, sentence macro or independent owner annotation is introduced.

predecessor_review.difference: The old idea asks a definite-to-anaphoric functional switch and requires independently bound owner history. This proposal keeps lexical denotations fixed and tests only exact written lengths in predeclared synonym sets. It neither reopens the semantic-function claim nor calls repeated lexical-family membership an observed individual-owner chain.

No recurrent one-group versus two/three-group rule in identical flanks. Here both alternatives remain one whole group, families come from an existing frozen whole reading, and the endpoint is a conditional within-paragraph ordering probability. No flank search or enlargement of GDT910's failed rule library.

The roadmap warns that isolated synonyms and boundary association do not establish an operator. This recipe predicts no operator: it adds a specific probabilistic rendering constraint to a fully declared reading, with exact conditional predictions beyond the named layout features.

The atomic-record rewrite route found no promotable operator and zero prior-record shortening instances. This is not another near-isomorphy search: it fixes six whole-form families and tests within-paragraph ordering of their literal lengths.
German pronoun rendering shortened the analyst's prose, not observed Voynich groups. No renderer-generated length or owner label enters this test.
Line-start and preceding-DY state already predict wrapper choice. These two factors are frozen conditioning variables here; reproducing their marginal association alone cannot meet the new endpoint.

Directed component backoff leaves exact whole identity and pair-specific boundary residuals. This recipe preserves exact form multisets and does not equate raw character length with a semantic decomposition or discard whole-form residuals.

smallest_decision_note.unknown: Whether the frozen Galen synonym assignments admit this one shared recurrence-conditioned spelling law outside their two development leaves after the stated layout conditioning. No target capacity or ordering statistic has been inspected for this question.
smallest_decision_note.smallest_adequate_work: One small reader over the existing packet, one exact count-state evaluator, one conditional null, and a validator reconstructing source IDs, whole-paragraph literal eligibility, family/rank/layout assignments and two-form analytical probabilities plus recomputed PREV_DY invariance in every null world. No decoder, source-world simulator, fitted language model or new corpus.
smallest_decision_note.before_execution: Root must review this complete contract and register a selected fixed test if desired. This RAW proposal does not execute itself, supply automatic follow-on authorization or imply any gate has passed.
smallest_decision_note.stop: At missing/mismatched source bytes, inconsistent paragraph identity, capacity failure, forbidden selector, invalid score gate, DP-state ceiling or the total wall-time cap, stop the declared step and preserve the exact reason. No repair chain, new target panel or alternate hypothesis follows automatically.

relations.detail: A different, directly observable spelling-choice consequence; no semantic definiteness/anaphora switch.
All 59 guesses and exactly six explicit synonym sets stay unchanged.
Different whole-group conditional ordering falsifier; old recurrent expansion failure retained.
Known entry-state effects are conditioned upon, not rediscovered as meanings.
